opportunities.title: International Payroll Analyst
opportunities.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

Reddit is seeking an experienced, highly analytical International Payroll Analyst to own and scale our international payroll operations across LATAM, EMEA, and APAC regions. As a key individual contributor with deep cross-functional influence, you will combine data-driven execution, meticulous attention to detail, and international tax compliance to support a rapidly growing workforce. Reporting to the Sr. Global Payroll Manager, this role will help to drive major strategic initiatives—including Workday enhancements and global payroll vendor implementations—to build scalable, best-in-class operational processes. The role partners closely with Payroll Vendors and internal teams across People, Finance, Tax, Legal, Treasury, Equity, and Internal Audit to deliver accurate, timely, compliant, and employee-centered payroll outcomes.

What You’ll Do:

  • International Payroll Execution & Oversight: 
    • Manage, audit, and execute multi-country payroll delivery across 15+ international countries, including payroll inputs, validation, approvals, funding coordination, reconciliations, statutory filings, and post-payroll activities ensure high accuracy and strict adherence to strict regional pay schedules.
    • Lead the payroll calendar and operating cadence across countries, proactively managing dependencies, cutoffs, exceptions, and risks to ensure employees are paid accurately and on time.
    • Partner with local in-country payroll providers to maintain strict adherence to regional pay schedules and statutory processing windows.
  • Compliance & Equity Management: Oversee international equity compensation payroll processing (RSUs, Stock Options) and ensure full regulatory compliance across international tax jurisdictions, localized statutory benefits, and reporting requirements.
  • Systems & Scaling Initiatives: Act as functional lead for payroll technology projects, leveraging Workday to automate workflows, optimize system configurations, build custom reporting, and partner with the Sr. Global payroll Manager to implement upcoming enterprise Global Payroll solutions.
  • Cross-Functional & Vendor Management: Partner with Benefits, People Operations, Legal, and Finance; manage external vendor relationships and third-party tax fulfillment partners to ensure seamless funds reconciliation and local tax compliance.
  • Process Controls: Establish, document, and enforce global payroll policies, SOX controls, and standard operating procedures to streamline audit readiness (401k, Workers’ Comp, Financial Audits).
  • Strategic Growth Projects: Support special business initiatives, including M&A integrations, new country market entries, and business-critical cross-functional launches.

 

What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience: 5+ y

opportunities.title: Team Lead - Internal Solution Consulting
opportunities.description: Contexte du rôle Le ou la Team Lead Solution Consulting est responsable de l’organisation, de la performance et du développement de l’équipe de Solution Consultants. L’équipe intervient auprès des clients Pennylane sur la dimension fonctionnelle de projets en cours : analyse des besoins, cadrage, mise en œuvre, formation et adoption du produit. Par son management, sa coordination et son pilotage de la capacité, le ou la Team Lead veille à ce que les clients bénéficient d’un accompagnement de qualité, au bon moment et avec le niveau d’expertise attendu. Missions principales Manager et développer l’équipe Solution Consulting : définir les objectifs individuels et collectifs, organiser les rituels de management, accompagner la montée en compétences, donner du feedback et suivre la performance. Veiller à l’engagement, à la motivation et à la dynamique collective. Organiser et optimiser le staffing de l’équipe : consolider les besoins liés aux projets en cours, anticiper la charge, répartir les missions en fonction des compétences et des disponibilités, et s’assurer que les ressources sont mobilisées au bon moment et sur les bons sujets. Définir les règles de priorisation et anticiper les tensions de capacité : construire des principes de priorisation et de staffing partagés avec les équipes Sales et les autres parties prenantes, arbitrer les demandes concurrentes, identifier les risques de surcharge ou de sous-capacité et alerter en cas de risque sur les délais ou la qualité. Superviser l’efficacité opérationnelle et la performance de l’équipe : définir et suivre les indicateurs clés de l’activité, notamment la couverture des besoins, les délais de staffing, la charge de l’équipe, le respect des engagements, la qualité des accompagnements et les difficultés liées à la coordination ou à la capacité. Garantir les standards de qualité et les méthodes de travail : définir et faire évoluer les bonnes pratiques applicables à l’analyse fonctionnelle, au cadrage, aux ateliers, aux formations, à la documentation et aux livrables produits par l’équipe. Coordonner les parties prenantes internes : faciliter la collaboration entre les Solution Consultants, les équipes Sales et Account Management, les PrM ou équipes Delivery, les CSM, Solution Engineering, Produit, Support, Operations et People. Développer l’amélioration continue de la fonction : analyser les retours terrain, identifier les irritants, faire évoluer les outils, les processus et les modes de fonctionnement, et faciliter la contribution de l’équipe aux demandes prioritaires, notamment aux réponses à des appels d’offres lorsque l’expertise fonctionnelle est requise et que la demande est priorisée selon les enjeux business. Profil recherché Vous justifiez d’au moins 2 ans d’expérience en management de proximité et dans l’accompagnement d’une équipe. Vous avez une expérience dans le pilotage d’une activité impliquant plusieurs projets, ressources, niveaux d’expertise et parties prenantes. Vous disposez d’une bonne compréhension des environnements de conseil fonctionnel, de déploiement logiciel, de formation, de Customer Success ou de Professional Services. Vous maîtrisez les enjeux de capacity planning, de staffing, d’allocation des ressources et de gestion de la charge. Vous savez définir des objectifs, suivre la performance, donner du feedback et accompagner les évolutions professionnelles. Vous êtes capable de structurer des processus, des standards et des méthodes de travail dans un environnement en évolution. Vous êtes à l’aise avec le pilotage par les données et la construction d’indicateurs opérationnels pertinents. Vous savez prioriser, arbitrer et prendre des décisions dans un contexte de demandes concurrentes. Vous disposez d’excellentes capacités de communication, de coordination et d’influence auprès d’équipes aux responsabilités différentes. Vous êtes orienté vers la qualité de l’expérience client, pragmatique, attentif au collectif et engagé dans l’amélioration continue

opportunities.title: Working Student - Procurement
opportunities.description: 📍 Location: Amsterdam ⏱ Weekly Hours: Between 16 -30 hours per week 📅 Start Date & Duration: Available immediately (6-month minimum commitment) Join Fastned at the forefront of Europe’s electric vehicle and charging infrastructure revolution! Since 2012, Fastned has been building and operating a rapidly growing network of iconic fast-charging stations powered entirely by solar and wind energy — now spanning over 400 stations across nine countries in Europe. Our goal is 1,000 stations in prime locations. About the role We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Working Student with a strong passion for data, analytics and procurement . In this role, you will play a key part and help build the foundations of Procurement at Fastned. In this role, you will be part of the Procurement Team, reporting to the Head of Procurement and collaborating closely with the Finance, Legal, and cross-functional teams spanning Construction, Operations, Technology & Engineering, and IT. Procurement at Fastned is designed to support the business, not constrain it. The Procurement function does not make unilateral decisions about supplier or product selection. Instead, it brings structure, market insight, commercial expertise and oversight. You will help put this approach into practice. What you’ll be doing Dive into our supplier and purchasing data to uncover spending patterns, spot smart consolidation opportunities, and identify potential savings. Research market developments, map out supplier landscapes, and benchmark pricing and services across Fastned’s key procurement categories. Help set the team up for success in commercial negotiations by preparing clear supplier profiles, spend insights, and negotiation briefs. Keep track of how our suppliers are performing across cost, quality, delivery, and ESG—helping prepare supplier reviews and following up on agreed next steps. Help build and maintain practical procurement templates, guidelines, and sourcing documentation that make buying at Fastned smooth and transparent. Support our Procurement Champions across different teams by sharing handy tools, templates, and everyday guidance. Coordinate meetings and workshops with internal teams and suppliers, making sure decisions and follow-up actions are clearly captured. Who we are looking for You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s programme (ideally in Business, Economics, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field) with a genuine interest in procurement, supplier management, or commercial negotiations. You enjoy diving into data, spreadsheets, and complex information to turn them into clear, actionable insights. You’re confident with Excel and PowerPoint, and experience with data visualisation or procurement tools is a great plus. You take initiative, ask thoughtful questions, and work well independently, while handling sensitive commercial and financial information with discretion. You communicate clearly and enjoy partnering with stakeholders across different teams and backgrounds. Fluency in English is essential, and any additional European language is a bonus. You’re excited about Fastned’s mission and eager to play an active part in accelerating the energy transition. What you’ll learn In this role, you will gain practical experience in: Procurement category management and strategic sourcing Supplier and contract management Spend analysis, RFP and tender processes Commercial negotiations Procurement governance and stakeholder management Building a new Procurement function in a fast-growing international company What you get out of it Beyond a meaningful working student role at a company actively accelerating Europe's energy transition, here's what we offer: Flexibility that fits your schedule . We'll coordinate your working hours around your studies, no forced trade-offs between work and university. Daily lunches, snacks and drinks at our Amsterdam office . opportunities.title: Data Engineering Intern
opportunities.description: Metyis is growing! We are looking for a Data Engineering Intern to join our Data and Analytics team, in Amsterdam. As a Data Engineering Intern, you will be involved in turning our clients´ business into a more data-driven one. Who we are Metyis is a global and forward-thinking firm operating across a wide range of industries, developing and delivering Big Data, Digital Commerce, Marketing & Design solutions and Advisory services. At Metyis, our long-term partnership model brings long-lasting impact and growth to our business partners and clients through extensive execution capabilities. With our team, you can experience a collaborative environment with highly skilled multidisciplinary experts, where everyone has room to build bigger and bolder ideas. Being part of Metyis means you can speak your mind and be creative with your knowledge. Imagine the things you can achieve with a team that encourages you to be the best version of yourself. We are Metyis. Partners for Impact. What we offer Intensive training from our super skilled Data engineering team on topics like data warehousing, data pipelines, distributed computing using Pyspark, data modelling & data lake. Relevant working experience on a live business case. Interact with clients regularly to drive their business towards impactful change. Play a key role in the team by creating new business solutions via data-driven insights. Receive guidance by a dedicated mentor to make sure you make the most out of your time at Metyis. Experience being part of a fast-growing international and diverse team. What you will do Assisting in the design, development, and maintenance of data pipelines to extract, transform and load data from various sources. Helping with data warehousing and data modelling activities. Participating in the creation of data-driven solutions to support business needs. Collaborating with data scientists, business analysts and software engineers to understand and implement data requirements. Implementing data quality and data governance processes. Participating in code reviews and providing constructive feedback. Staying up to date with the latest developments in data engineering technologies and best practices. What you’ll bring Pursuing a degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field. Strong programming skills in one or more programming languages such as Python, Java, or Scala. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work well in a team environment. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Passion for Data: A strong interest in data and technology, and a desire to learn and grow as a data engineer. At Metyis, we are driven by curiosity and collaboration. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB) in all its forms as it makes us stronger as an organisation and promotes creativity and innovation. We welcome all talents and are committed to creating a workplace where every employee can make a meaningful impact and grow. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
